reason: H0 exclusively enables WUFFS_CONFIG__MODULE__JSON and invokes wuffs_json__decoder__decode_tokens or wuffs_aux::DecodeJson; it never constructs or drives the NIE decoder. Consequently, S1's animated NIA input format and stateful image-decoder protocol receive no fuzz coverage.
evidence: H0 defines WUFFS_CONFIG__MODULE__AUX__JSON and WUFFS_CONFIG__MODULE__JSON, with no NIE module.
H0's fuzz_complex and fuzz_simple only call wuffs_json__decoder__decode_tokens; fuzz_cpp only calls wuffs_aux::DecodeJson.
